opportunities.title: The 'Three Choices' Prep Trick That Fixes Every Railroady Session
opportunities.why_now: Sly Flourish's new piece on three-choice prep is a direct hit for GMs refining session structure right now.
opportunities.angle: 60-sec short: break down the three-choices framework into a concrete 5e/Shadowdark prep checklist, end with a ruling on how to adjudicate player deviation mid-scene.

opportunities.title: Running First Watch: Who Actually Rolls Perception at Night?
opportunities.why_now: Tribality's new podcast on 'who's on first watch' spotlights a daily rules gap every table hits and ignores.
opportunities.angle: Rules-ruling short: lay out RAW on passive Perception during watches in 5e vs. Shadowdark's simpler light/dark checks, give a table-ready fix.

opportunities.title: Survival Horror D&D: How Lamordia Breaks Your Short Rest Economy
opportunities.why_now: Project_Lamordia just launched on D&D Beyond, bringing modern survival-horror pacing into 5e content.
opportunities.angle: Mechanical breakdown: show how removing/restricting short rests changes spell-slot math and monster tactics in a horror one-shot, with a concrete HP/resource example.

opportunities.title: Dragon Magazine's Forgotten Monster Tactic That Still Wrecks Low-Level Parties
opportunities.why_now: Dragon Reflections #106 just dropped, revisiting classic Dragon Magazine content that's catnip for DCC/OSR nostalgia.
opportunities.angle: Creature tactic short: pull one old-school monster ability from the era covered in issue #106, translate it into a DCC or 5e stat block ambush tactic.

opportunities.title: Pirate Borg's Panic Table Is the Morale Mechanic 5e Is Missing
opportunities.why_now: This week's RPG print roundup highlights Pirate Borg, a system whose panic/morale mechanics OSR-curious 5e GMs keep asking about.
opportunities.angle: Cross-system ruling: demo Pirate Borg's panic check, then show a drop-in houserule version for 5e/Shadowdark monster morale when HP drops below half.
